channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont Democrats won a veto-proof majority in the state Senate and expanded their House control in this year's election. They flipped multiple seats, including in Orange and Addison counties. Party leaders credit national politics and strong candidates for the gains.
Authorities are looking for a vehicle involved in a crash near West Rutland Town Hall. The crash damaged signage on the town hall's front lawn. Investigations are ongoing.

Vermont's Department for Children and Families got a two hundred thousand dollar grant to simplify foster parent fingerprinting. Mobile fingerprinting units will reduce travel for applicants in rural areas. This supports efforts to increase foster family availability for children under state care.
Lincoln Vermont had a New York City parking ticket rescinded. The ticket was for a five-ton wheel-loader that never left the garage. New York City officials admitted the error and canceled the fine.
